propositions: Dependabot PR #131 must be re-authored as a Gerrit change and merged to main because GitHub is a read-only mirror that rejects direct PR merges.
Bumping ruff and mypy tool versions can surface new lint and typecheck findings that must be fixed in code without suppressions; no # noqa or # type: ignore directives are permitted.

The uv lock must be regenerated with the project's uv workflow for the five grouped packages (botocore, genai-prices, json-repair, mypy, ruff), accepting current upstream resolutions rather than pinning to stale PR versions.
All gates (make lint, make typecheck, complexity ratchet, CI suite) must pass green under the new tool versions with zero source code changes; the complexity baseline file must remain unmodified.
After Gerrit merge, PR #131 must be verified closed via GitHub API; if not auto-closed by the mirror sync, it must be closed manually with a comment naming the Gerrit change.
